events.description: Email sent proposing a meeting on Tuesday 1-3 pm to compare notes on Khallad in Asia and al-Mihdar in Malaysia

A CIA officer emails a colleague saying they need to compare notes on Khallad being in Asia and Khalid al-Mihdhar being in Malaysia. The author cannot see Khallad in the material and suggests either missing something or seeing something that was not there.

A planned expert-to-expert meeting, set for the following Tuesday from 1 to 3 pm, to compare notes on Khallad and Khalid al-Mihdhar. The date is inferred from the email's sent date of 24 May 2001, a Thursday.

relationships.detail: The email author refers to Khallad being in Asia, which was their interpretation and that of others.
relationships.quote: Re Khallad in Asia, that was my (and I assume others') interpreation

relationships.detail: The email notes Khalid al-Mihdar was in Malaysia, while the author could not see Khallad there.

key_claims: CIA analysts in May 2001 were comparing notes on whether Khallad was in Asia/Malaysia alongside Khalid al-Mihdar.
One analyst could not see Khallad in the material regarding Mihdar in Malaysia and suggested either missing something or others saw something not there.
